Template independent

No sanitized corporate PPTX required

At export time the work template is the container. Visualizer finds or receives the middle content rectangle, then maps canonical grid placements into that region.

  • Named placeholder or user-selected rectangle wins.
  • Otherwise the largest safe empty central region is detected.
  • Headers, footers, logos, masters and backgrounds stay untouched.
  • Overflow reflows or creates a new template slide instead of shrinking below readability floors.
